title: Death by Terror
text: “Guh—ah, ahhhh… c-curse you… d-damn it.”
A spear had plunged deep into Trash’s body double’s chest, and it reached out its hand resentfully toward the sight of Crocodile Guy and Rabbit Guy fighting over Father.
“Oh my, this is certainly destroying its dignity, isn’t it…? Getting shoved during a lovers’ quarrel and impaled on a spear—what a pathetic way to die.”
Itsuki chuckled, mocking Trash’s body double with obvious satisfaction.
“Well then, since Burst Lance is on cooldown, let’s try light this time. This one suits you perfectly! Brionac X!”
“T-this can’t be! Curse these beastmen—!?”
I erased Trash’s body double, just like that looping version of Trash before.

“Now then… the one left is that person, isn’t it? I didn’t miss you smirking and laughing while watching the footage I showed. I’ve gotten permission from the Queen too, so please die drowning in humiliation.”
“Bwuh bwuh! Bwuhihi!”

“Oh, you were deceived? People like you always say that line. I saw a few others say it too during my time on the run. Since I already know you won’t do anything worthwhile, I’ll finish you off quickly.”
“Bwuhyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!?”
With a whoosh, Itsuki shot straight through the crimson pig’s forehead, finishing it off.
『Curse youuuuuu』
『I won’t forgiveee you』
『Bwuh bwuh… bwuhiiiiiii』
Having met such regrettable ends, their souls—now seeds of vengeful spirits dominated by rage—let out screams. Left alone, it was plain to see they’d become malevolent spirits and turn into monsters.
“It’d be a pain if they turned into evil spirits, so I’ll grant them a second death of the soul, I say.”
I switched to Soul Eater Spear and delivered the finishing blow to them, indeed.
『Gya!?』
『T-the world—does it accept that these evil beastmen run rampant—』
『Bwuhyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!』
When I finished off the crimson pig’s soul, the surroundings trembled violently. The Queen and Trash were startled by the screams.
“Just now, I heard some tremendous screaming, but…”
“What was that…”
“By the way, Aultcray… you’ve taken on quite an interesting form. If you let me investigate a bit more, I might show that child a little mercy. Fufu.”
“M-my queen! Please stop treating me as a pet!”
The Queen wore a mocking smile at Trash, who was drowning in humiliation.
“…This doesn’t look like a place for the Heroes’ victory pose,” said the companions who’d been watching the proceedings like furniture beside Ren, who’d simply observed from the sidelines.
“R-Ren-sama… um, while we were dealing with the soldiers rushing in, the battle just… ended?”
“That’s right. Motoyasu and his group finished it off.”
“At some point, those guys over there just vanished. I could tell they’d been blown away by some huge explosion, but…”
“Seems that way. Well, our side was in total chaos thanks to Naofumi and company, so it couldn’t be helped.”
“Ren-sama, let’s strike a victory pose here. Rafumi-sama always struck a pose at times like this.”
“Right, no need for that.”
“But… I think it’d be better to declare, ‘This is the victory of we, the Black Brave Knights!’”
“Why would I need to do that! Don’t let Rafumi corrupt you!”
“At the very least, let’s do a victory motion. Ren-sama! In that form, I’ll toss this to you, so please catch it and raise your sword high!”
“Don’t throw a bone and expect me to catch it!”
It seemed Ren had been taught a victory pose by Rafumi and was now being dragged into performing it too.
“Geez… and after Keel-san and I worked so hard researching and practicing it…”
“Why do I have to know that Keel’s been practicing in my place under the Inult category!”
Ren and his companions were bickering away.
“Spear Hero sure has a sharp head for this kind of thing, nano. Old habits die hard, nano?”
“Hmph. I trained my wits solving problems for pigs, drawing on some rather embarrassing memories from my past. How was that, I say?”

Applying the logic of thinking about what the enemy expects and how they’ll move, I’d devised something humiliating and regrettable for the enemy. Of course, there were surely ways to torment them slowly and drawn-out, but that sounded like too much trouble, so I didn’t bother thinking that far, indeed.
“By the way, Rival. Turning them beastman-like through an application of your monsterization magic and then tossing them in a cell—that’s dignity destruction too, I say.”
“Oh? Is there such a spell? That does sound interesting indeed. A bit of a shame, really. Could you use it on the next oddball we come across?”
Itsuki, too, seemed to desire that particular punishment.
“Haah… Spear Hero suggests the most outrageous things, nano.”
Looking toward the voice, there was a surviving bystander soldier who’d gone weak in the knees.
“Ah, there’s a fine test subject.”
I’d only muttered that, but suddenly the soldier’s eyes rolled back and he dropped dead.
“Seems he died of fear, nano.”
Incidentally, it was Rival who’d instantly cast a spell to finish him off. I could tell. Some of Rival’s magic was beyond even this looping Itsuki’s ability to detect.
“Oh dear… what a shame.”
It seemed Itsuki, despite his suspicions, had no intention of pressing the matter further.
“More importantly, stop fighting over Father, I say!”
“You’re the one who started it, Motoyasu-kuuuuuun!”
Father’s voice echoed through the throne room.
“Naofumi… so this is what happens when you take fairy form… your subordinate’s turned into something like Luna, no, even more incredible than Luna.”
“Hey, Ren! Why are you so impressed by this!”
“Iwatani-sama! Let’s flee from here!”
“Theo, why are we running!?”
“Because Shion’s trying to steal you away!”
And with that, Rabbit Guy scooped Father up like a rugby ball and tried to make a break for it.
“Wait! I won’t let you get away! That belongs to me!”
“Shion, calm down too! Hey! You’re all in chaos! Hurry up and turn them back! Amaki-dono!”
“Honestly… anyway, this means the Three Heroes Church’s occupation of the castle is finished.”

Right after, Ren cast Fairy Morph, restoring Father to his original form, and Crocodile Guy and Rabbit Guy came back to their senses. Trash was also returned to normal fairly quickly. Even though it had only been temporary, having taken on a beastman-like fairy form seemed to have been quite a humiliation for Trash. Still, I thought his expression, seen by the Queen, hadn’t looked entirely displeased. And so the remaining few Three Heroes Church followers occupying the castle were captured. For those who’d failed to flee despite having the chance—well, that was their own fault, nano—and Rival applied her monsterization magic to give them beastman-like appearances as punishment, continuing until Itsuki was satisfied, thereby neutralizing them, indeed.

And so… traces of the Three Heroes Church’s rampage remained in Melromarc. The people of Melromarc’s castle town seemed rather bewildered by the return of Father and the Queen. Here, now, a nation was on the verge of being reborn.

The Three Heroes Church’s rampage—illegally occupying the castle and attempting to replace the king on their own—was brought to light. By editing and spreading part of the video evidence Itsuki possessed throughout the country, we spread the narrative that the three Heroes—myself, Ren, and Itsuki—had judged the Three Heroes Church to be evil and, in cooperation with the Queen, defeated them, making clear who the villain truly was. It reportedly didn’t take long for the rumor to spread that the incidents occurring within the country weren’t the fault of Father, the Wave and Shield Hero, but rather the result of the Three Heroes Church’s illegal misdeeds. Even some of the missing persons apparently trickled back once the Three Heroes Church was officially designated a heretical cult. Apparently they’d been in hiding until the chaos settled down—mostly deserters from the fortress, it seemed. Humans have a certain mentality of not wanting to believe they themselves were the villains. So rather than reflecting on the fact that they’d participated in wrongdoing, they instead claimed they’d been uninvolved, shifting all blame onto a clearly defined evil. And so, with the castle now safe, we brought along Fiancée and the other related parties, along with the army the Queen had led, and made our triumphant return.
